name: Zyrox Mining International, Inc.
summary: Zyrox Mining International, Inc. currently maintains no substantial business operations. Its primary objective involves acquiring another entity, a goal it intends to achieve through methods such as a reverse merger, an asset purchase, or comparable transactions. This New York, New York-based company was established in 2009 and operated under the name Diversified Energy & Fuel International, Inc. until August 2012, when it officially rebranded as Zyrox Mining International, Inc.
